ch2_q26.doctrine: Section 54 Exemption & Integrated Residential Unit Doctrine

root.title: Section 54: Integrated Unit Doctrine
root.badge: Section 54 · CIT v. D. Ananda Basappa
root.voice_sync_text: Section 54 പ്രകാരം Long-term Capital Gain Claim ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ adjacent flats വാങ്ങി single unit ആയി മാറ്റിയാൽ exemption ലഭിക്കുമോ എന്ന് നമുക്ക് പരിശോധിക്കാം.

points.title: Eligibility & Reinvestment Timelines
body: Transfer of a Long-term Capital Asset being a residential house property.
Purchase of new residential house within 1 year before or 2 years after transfer, or construction within 3 years.

highlights.phrase: within 1 year before or 2 years after

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54(1) പ്രകാരം long-term residential house property transfer ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ 1 year before അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 2 years after purchase നടത്തണം, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 3 years-നുള്ളിൽ construction പൂർത്തിയാക്കണം.

points.title: Monetary Restriction & Statutory Threshold
body: If Long-term Capital Gain exceeds ₹ 2 Crore, exemption is strictly restricted to one residential house in India.
Maximum exemption under Section 54 is capped at ₹ 10 Crore w.e.f. A.Y. 2024-25.
points.voice_sync_text: Long-term Capital Gain 2 Crore രൂപയിൽ കൂടുതൽ ആണെങ്കിൽ exemption ഒരു residential house-ലേക്ക് മാത്രമായി restrict ചെയ്യപ്പെടും.

points.title: Physical Integration & Intention Test
body: Purchase of contiguous or adjacent flats modified into a single integrated residential unit qualifies as one residential house.
Architect or builder certification of structural modification establishes single unit status.

highlights.phrase: modified into a single integrated residential unit

points.voice_sync_text: adjacent flats വാങ്ങി physical modifications വഴി single unit ആക്കി മാറ്റിയാൽ, അത് നിയമപരമായി one residential house ആയി തന്നെ പരിഗണിക്കും എന്ന് CIT v. D. Ananda Basappa കേസിൽ കർണാടക ഹൈക്കോടതി വിധിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്.

points.title: Irrelevance of Deeds and Prior Occupation
body: Purchase via separate sale deeds from different sellers does not disentitle exemption under Section 54.
Occupation of flats by different tenants prior to acquisition is irrelevant if converted into one unit post-acquisition.

highlights.phrase: does not disentitle exemption under Section 54

points.voice_sync_text: വ്യത്യസ്ത sale deeds വഴി വാങ്ങിയതുകൊണ്ടോ, പർച്ചേസിന് മുൻപ് വേറെ tenants താമസിച്ചിരുന്നു എന്നതുകൊണ്ടോ Section 54 exemption നിഷേധിക്കാൻ Assessing Officer-ക്ക് സാധിക്കില്ല.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Section 54: Exemption for Integrated Residential Units
statutory_assumptions: Assessee derives Long-term Capital Gain exceeding ₹ 2 Crore from sale of residential house.
Purchases 2 contiguous adjacent flats and effects structural integration into 1 single residential apartment unit.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: നമുക്ക് ഈ നിയമതത്വം ഒരു simple numerical illustration വഴി കണ്ടു മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.title: Original Capital Asset Sale
steps.voice_sync_text: ആദ്യമായി, ഒരു Assessee residential house വിറ്റ് 3 Crore രൂപ Long-term Capital Gain ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നു.

steps.title: Acquisition of Two Adjacent Units
steps.voice_sync_text: Assessee തൊട്ടടുത്ത് കിടക്കുന്ന രണ്ട് flats രണ്ട് വെവ്വേറെ sale deeds വഴി ആകെ 2.5 Crore രൂപയ്ക്ക് വാങ്ങുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: Isometric cutaway diagram showing two side-by-side apartment units on the same floor of a high-rise building, clear interior walls dividing them, 2.5D architectural isometric vector style.

steps.title: Structural Integration into One Unit
steps.voice_sync_text: തുടർന്ന്, ഇടയിലുള്ള ചുമര് പൊളിച്ച് ഒരൊറ്റ apartment ആക്കി മാറ്റുകയും builder അതിനുള്ള certificate നൽകുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: Isometric 3D render of the same two apartments, with the central dividing wall removed and an elegant open doorway interconnecting them into a single spacious flat, architectural blueprint overlay.

steps.title: Section 54 Exemption Assessment
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇത് legally one residential house ആയതിനാൽ, 2.5 Crore രൂപയുടെ മുഴുവൻ നിക്ഷേപത്തിനും Section 54 exemption അനുവദനീയമാണ്.
steps.image_prompt: A clean financial tax computation dashboard displaying full approval of Section 54 exemption, green compliance checkmarks, isometric 3D visual style.

root.title: Compulsory Acquisition & Section 54D
root.voice_sync_text: Welcome students. Today, we are analyzing the statutory mechanism of compulsory acquisition under Section 45(5) and the exemption benefit available for industrial undertakings under Section 54D.

points.title: Year of Taxability
body: Capital gains arise in the year of compulsory acquisition transfer.
Taxability is deferred to the year in which initial compensation is received.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 45(5) പ്രകാരം compulsory acquisition transfer നടക്കുമ്പോൾ taxable capital gain arise ചെയ്യുമെങ്കിലും, tax liability വരുന്നത് actual initial compensation is received ചെയ്യുന്ന Financial Year-ൽ ആയിരിക്കും.

points.title: Prior Use & Investment Window
body: Asset must be land or building used for industrial undertaking for at least 2 years prior to transfer.
Reinvestment must be made within 3 years after transfer date in industrial land or building.

highlights.phrase: at least 2 years prior to transfer

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54D exemption ലഭിക്കണമെങ്കിൽ, compulsorily acquired asset industrial undertaking-നു വേണ്ടി at least 2 years prior to transfer ഉപയോഗിച്ചിരിക്കണം. Transfer date-ൽ നിന്ന് within 3 years after transfer date പുതിയ industrial asset purchase ചെയ്തിരിക്കണം.

points.title: Exemption & Lock-in Consequence
body: Exemption equals lower of capital gains or cost of new asset.
If new asset is transferred within 3 years, cost of acquisition is reduced by exempted gain.

highlights.phrase: lower of capital gains or cost of new asset

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54D പ്രകാരമുള്ള deduction എന്നത് lower of capital gains or cost of new asset ആയിരിക്കും. ഇനി ഈ പുതിയ asset 3 years-നുള്ളിൽ transfer ചെയ്താൽ, അതിന്റെ cost of acquisition is reduced by the earlier exempted capital gain.

statutory_assumptions: Industrial land acquired 5 years prior and used continuously for industrial undertaking.
Compulsory acquisition by government with statutory compensation received in full.
New industrial land purchased within the prescribed 3-year statutory window.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി ഈ statutory rule എങ്ങനെയാണ് ഒരു practical computation-ൽ apply ചെയ്യുന്നതെന്ന് ഒരു simple visual example വഴി നോക്കാം.

steps.title: Industrial Land Acquisition & 2-Year Usage
steps.voice_sync_text: ഒരു assessee ₹ 5,00,000 രൂപയ്ക്ക് ഒരു industrial land വാങ്ങുകയും, continuous ആയി 2 years-ൽ കൂടുതൽ industrial undertaking-ന് ഉപയോഗിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: An industrial plot with a working factory setup, subtle blue isometric lighting showing a legal ownership deed floating above, dramatic 2.5D visual style.

steps.title: Compulsory Acquisition & Compensation
steps.voice_sync_text: Government ഈ land compulsorily acquire ചെയ്യുകയും, ₹ 20,00,000 compensation പൂർണ്ണമായും 지급 ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു. Section 45(5) പ്രകാരം taxability receipt year-ൽ വരുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: Government acquisition seal overlaid on the industrial factory plot, glowing legal notification board with ₹ 20,00,000 compensation text, cinematic isometric perspective.

steps.title: Reinvestment in New Industrial Asset
steps.voice_sync_text: Assessee 3 years window-നുള്ളിൽ പുതിയ industrial land ₹ 12,00,000 രൂപയ്ക്ക് purchase ചെയ്യുന്നു. ഇത് Section 54D പ്രകാരം exemption-ന് eligible ആണ്.
steps.image_prompt: A brand new vacant industrial plot with modern architectural blueprints floating over it, highlighting reinvestment, golden isometric lighting.

steps.title: Net Taxable Capital Gain Computation
steps.voice_sync_text: Total Capital Gain ₹ 15,00,000-ൽ നിന്ന് new asset cost ആയ ₹ 12,00,000 Section 54D exemption ആയി subtract ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ Net Taxable Capital Gain ₹ 3,00,000 ആയി ലഭിക്കുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A modern digital ledger displaying the computation breakdown with high tech glowing blue numbers and a final green stamp saying TAXABLE CAPITAL GAIN.

calculation_data.formula: Compensation Received - Cost of Acquisition - Section 54D Exemption

root.title: Section 54F Exemption Scheme
root.voice_sync_text: Welcome! Today we are analyzing Section 54F capital gains exemption on long term capital assets other than a residential house.

points.title: Eligible Assessee & Asset Type
body: The original asset transferred must be a long-term capital asset other than a residential house.
The assessee must be an Individual or HUF acquiring a residential house in India.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 54F claim ചെയ്യണമെങ്കിൽ assessee ഒരു Individual അല്ലെങ്കിൽ HUF ആയിരിക്കണം. Transfer ചെയ്തത് residential house ഒഴികെയുള്ള ഏതൊരു long-term capital asset ഉം ആവാം.

points.title: Computation of Exemption
body: If cost of new residential house equals or exceeds Net Consideration, the entire Capital Gain is exempt.
If cost of new house is less than Net Consideration, exempt amount is Proportional Capital Gain.
points.voice_sync_text: Net Consideration മുഴുവനായും new house ലെ reinvest ചെയ്താൽ entire Capital Gain is exempt. എന്നാൽ partial investment ആണെങ്കിൽ Proportional Capital Gain മാത്രമേ exempt ആകൂ.

points.title: Acquisition Timelines & CGAS Deposit
body: Acquisition must occur within 1 year before or 2 years after the date of transfer.
Construction of the residential house must be completed within 3 years from the date of transfer.
points.voice_sync_text: New house purchase ചെയ്യാൻ transfer-ന് 1 year before അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 2 years after സമയം ലഭിക്കും. Construction ആണെങ്കിൽ date of transfer-ൽ നിന്ന് 3 years ഉള്ളിൽ complete ചെയ്യണം.

points.title: Disqualification Conditions
body: Assessee must not own more than one residential house on the date of transfer.
Exemption is revoked if a second residential house is purchased within 2 years or constructed within 3 years.
points.voice_sync_text: Date of transfer-ൽ assessee-ക്ക് ഒന്നിൽ കൂടുതൽ residential house സ്വന്തമായി ഉണ്ടാകാൻ പാടില്ല. കൂടാതെ additional house വാങ്ങിയാൽ നേരത്തെ നൽകിയ exemption is revoked.

statutory_assumptions: Assessee transfers jewellery (Long-Term Capital Asset) during PY 2025-26.
Net Consideration after deducting transfer expenses is ₹ 20,00,000.
Computed Long-Term Capital Gain before exemption is ₹ 10,00,000.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി Section 54F exemption-ന്റെ mathematical working ഒരു simple illustration വഴി കാണാം.

steps.title: Transfer of Long-Term Capital Asset
steps.voice_sync_text: ആദ്യമായി, Long-Term Capital Asset വിറ്റ ശേഷം transfer expenses കുറച്ചുള്ള Net Consideration ₹ 20,00,000 ആണ് എന്ന് കരുതുക.
steps.image_prompt: A modern luxury jewellery box showcasing gold ornaments on a velvet cushion next to legal tax computation papers on a polished wooden desk, cinematic 2.5D isometric view, studio lighting.

steps.title: Computation of Long-Term Capital Gain
steps.voice_sync_text: Net Consideration-ൽ നിന്ന് cost minus ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ നമുക്ക് ലഭിക്കുന്ന Long-Term Capital Gain ₹ 10,00,000 ആണ്.
steps.image_prompt: A financial dashboard showing capital gain computation with tax icons and financial balance sheet, clean isometric 3D visual, blueprint blue background.

steps.title: Investment in Residential House
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇനി assessee ₹ 10,00,000 ചിലവഴിച്ച് ഒരു പുതിയ Residential House വാങ്ങുന്നു. ഇവിടെ investment, Net Consideration-നേക്കാൾ കുറവാണ്.
steps.image_prompt: An architect model of a contemporary single-family residential house with a green lawn, vibrant isometric style, soft architectural lighting.

steps.title: Proportional Exemption & Taxable LTCG
steps.voice_sync_text: Section 54F പ്രകാരം Exempt LTCG = ₹ 10 Lakhs into ₹ 10 Lakhs by ₹ 20 Lakhs, അതായത് ₹ 5,00,000. ബാക്കി ₹ 5,00,000 Taxable LTCG ആകുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A digital calculator screen showing the formula breakdown with checkmarks and tax exemption seal, high contrast isometric vector render.

calculation_data.formula: Taxable LTCG = Total LTCG - [LTCG × (Cost of New House / Net Consideration)]

ch2_q29.doctrine: Capital Gains: Valuation Rules, Pre-2001 Cost Ceiling & Section 54 Cap

root.title: Capital Gains: Valuation Rules & Section 54 Statutory Cap
root.voice_sync_text: നമസ്കാരം, ഇന്ന് നമ്മൾ പഠിക്കുന്നത് Capital Gains Head-ലെ മൂന്ന് പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട statutory rules ആണ്: Section 50C tolerance limit, Section 55(2)(b) pre-2001 cost valuation rule, കൂടാതെ Section 54 exemption statutory ceiling limit.

branches.branch_title: Section 50C: Stamp Duty Valuation & Tolerance Band

points.title: 110% Safe Harbor Tolerance Rule
body: If Stamp Duty Value does not exceed 110% of actual consideration, actual consideration is taken as Full Value of Consideration.
If Stamp Duty Value exceeds 110% of actual consideration, Stamp Duty Value becomes Full Value of Consideration.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 50C അനുസരിച്ച്, transfer ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ statutory authority നിശ്ചയിച്ച Stamp Duty Value, actual consideration-ന്റെ 110% വരെ ആണെങ്കിൽ, actual consideration തന്നെയാണ് Full Value of Consideration ആയി എടുക്കുക. 110% കവിഞ്ഞാൽ മാത്രമേ Stamp Duty Value ഫുൾ കൺസിഡറേഷനായി എടുക്കേണ്ടതുള്ളൂ.

points.title: FMV Restriction to 01.04.2001 Stamp Duty Value
body: Cost of Acquisition for pre-2001 asset is Higher of actual cost or FMV as on 1st April 2001.
FMV as on 1st April 2001 cannot exceed Stamp Duty Value as on 1st April 2001.

highlights.phrase: Higher of actual cost or FMV as on 1st April 2001
cannot exceed Stamp Duty Value as on 1st April 2001

points.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2001-ന് മുൻപ് വാങ്ങിയിട്ടുള്ള ഒരു capital asset ആണെങ്കിൽ, Cost of Acquisition ആയി actual cost അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 1st April 2001-ലെ Fair Market Value ഇതാണ് നമ്മൾ താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യുക. എന്നാൽ 1st April 2001-ലെ Fair Market Value ഒരിക്കലും അവിടുത്തെ Stamp Duty Value-നേക്കാൾ കൂട്ടാൻ പാടില്ല.

points.title: Investment Eligibility & CGAS Deposit Timeline
body: Investment in residential plot or house purchase or construction qualifies for Section 54 exemption.
Unutilized amount deposited in Capital Gain Account Scheme before Section 139(1) return filing date is eligible for exemption.

highlights.phrase: Capital Gain Account Scheme before Section 139(1)

points.voice_sync_text: Residential house transfer ചെയ്ത് കിട്ടുന്ന Long-Term Capital Gain ഉപയോഗിച്ച് പുതിയ residential property വാങ്ങുകയോ നിർമ്മിക്കുകയോ ചെയ്യാം. Section 139(1) തീയതിക്ക് മുമ്പ് ചിലവാക്കാത്ത തുക Capital Gain Account Scheme-ൽ നിക്ഷേപിച്ചാലും Section 54 exemption ലഭിക്കും.

points.title: Maximum ₹ 10 Crore Exemption Limit
body: Maximum allowable exemption under Section 54 is capped at ₹ 10 Crores.
If total investment and CGAS deposit exceed ₹ 10 Crores, maximum exemption is restricted to ₹ 10 Crores.
points.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ ഏറ്റവും പ്രധാനമായി ശ്രദ്ധിക്കേണ്ട കാര്യം, Assessment Year 2024-25 മുതൽ Section 54 exemption-ന്റെ maximum limit ₹ 10 Crores ആയി ക്ലിപ്പ് ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ട്. അതുകൊണ്ട് ആകെ ഇൻവെസ്റ്റ്മെന്റും deposit-ഉം ₹ 10 Crores-ൽ കൂടുതൽ വന്നാലും, maximum exemption ₹ 10 Crores മാത്രമേ ലഭിക്കൂ.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Capital Gains: Section 50C Tolerance, Pre-2001 Valuation & Section 54 Ceiling
statutory_assumptions: Assessee sells a long-term residential house property.
Property was originally purchased prior to 1st April 2001.
Assessee invests in a new residential plot and deposits funds in CGAS.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി ഇത് ഒരു simple numerical walkthrough വഴി വ്യക്തമായി മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.title: Determination of Full Value of Consideration (Section 50C)
steps.voice_sync_text: ആദ്യമായി, actual sale price 15.50 Crores രൂപയും Stamp Duty Value 17 Crores രൂപയുമാണെന്ന് കരുതുക. 15.50 Crores-ന്റെ 110 percentage എന്നത് 17.05 Crores ആണ്. Stamp Duty Value ഇതിൽ കവിയാത്തതുകൊണ്ട്, actual sale price ആയ 15.50 Crores തന്നെയാണ് Full Value of Consideration.
steps.image_prompt: A modern luxury villa with a sale deed glowing under bright studio lighting, displaying digital hologram tags of Sale Price and Stamp Duty Value in 2.5D isometric view.

steps.title: Cost of Acquisition for Pre-2001 Asset (Section 55(2)(b))
steps.voice_sync_text: രണ്ടാമതായി, asset 1993-ൽ വാങ്ങിയതാണ്. Actual cost 45 Lakhs, 01.04.2001-ലെ Fair Market Value 1.20 Crores, എന്നാൽ അവിടുത്തെ Stamp Duty Value 1.02 Crores ആണെങ്കിൽ, FMV 1.02 Crores ആയി പരിമിതപ്പെടും. അതിനാൽ Cost of Acquisition 1.02 Crores ആയിരിക്കും.
steps.image_prompt: An vintage architectural blueprint from 1st April 2001 with glowing tax scales comparing Actual Cost, Fair Market Value, and Stamp Duty Value ceiling in 2.5D visual style.

steps.title: Gross Long-Term Capital Gains Calculation
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇനി Full Value of Consideration 15.50 Crores-ൽ നിന്ന് Cost of Acquisition 1.02 Crores കുറച്ചാൽ Gross Long-Term Capital Gain 14.48 Crores രൂപ എന്ന് ലഭിക്കുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A clean 2.5D digital display presenting the subtraction box glowing in gold neon light, showing Gross Long Term Capital Gain.

steps.title: Section 54 Statutory Exemption Cap & Net Taxable Gain
steps.voice_sync_text: Assessee പുതിയ plot വാങ്ങാനും CGAS-ൽ ഇടാനുമായി ആകെ 11 Crores ചിലവഴിച്ചാലും, Section 54 പ്രകാരം maximum exemption limit 10 Crores രൂപയിൽ നിജപ്പെടുത്തിയിരിക്കുന്നു. അതിനാൽ 14.48 Crores-ൽ നിന്ന് 10 Crores കുറച്ചാൽ Net Taxable LTCG 4.48 Crores രൂപയാകും.
steps.image_prompt: A visual barrier wall representing the statutory maximum limit of 10 Crore rupees under Section 54, with excess capital gain passing into the Taxable Gain meter in 2.5D style.

calculation_data.formula: Gross LTCG - Section 54 Exemption (Capped at ₹ 10 Cr)

ch2_q30.doctrine: House Property & Capital Gains Statutory Framework

root.title: House Property & Capital Gains Framework
root.badge: Sec 23 · Sec 24 · Sec 25A · Sec 49(1) · Sec 50C · Sec 54 · Sec 54EC
root.voice_sync_text: House Property Income compute ചെയ്യുമ്പോഴും, Capital Asset transfer ചെയ്യുമ്പോഴും ബാധകമാകുന്ന പ്രധാന statutory provisions നമുക്ക് ഈ ലെക്ചറിലൂടെ പരിശോധിക്കാം.

points.title: Determination of GAV and Municipal Taxes
body: Gross Annual Value is higher of Expected Rent and Actual Rent received or receivable.
Municipal taxes paid by the owner including arrears are deductible from Gross Annual Value.

highlights.phrase: higher of Expected Rent and Actual Rent

points.voice_sync_text: Section 23 പ്രകാരം Gross Annual Value എന്നത് Expected Rent, Actual Rent എന്നിവയിൽ ഉയർന്ന തുകയാണ്. Assessee അടച്ച കഴിഞ്ഞ വർഷങ്ങളിലെ arrears ഉൾപ്പെടെയുള്ള Municipal Taxes മുഴുവനായും GAV-ൽ നിന്ന് subtract ചെയ്യാം.

points.title: Deductions under Section 24
body: Standard deduction allowed at 30% of Net Annual Value under Section 24(a).
Interest on borrowed capital for major repairs or construction is fully deductible under Section 24(b) for let-out property.
points.voice_sync_text: Net Annual Value കണ്ടെത്തഴിഞ്ഞാൽ Section 24(a) അനുസരിച്ച് flat 30% Standard Deduction ലഭിക്കും. കൂടാതെ property repairs-ന് എടുത്ത ലോണിന്റെ Interest, Section 24(b) പ്രകാരം deduction ആയി കിട്ടും.

points.title: Taxability & Statutory Deduction for Rent Arrears
body: Arrears of rent received are taxable in the year of receipt after a statutory deduction of 30%.
Taxable irrespective of whether the assessee remains the owner of the property in the receipt year.

highlights.phrase: remains the owner of the property

points.voice_sync_text: Section 25A പ്രകാരം Arrears of rent ലഭിക്കുന്ന വര്‍ഷത്തിൽ അതിൽ നിന്നും 30% statutory deduction கழிച്ച് ബാക്കി തുക Taxable ആകും. ആ വര്‍ഷം property അസ്സസ്സീയുടെ കയ്യിൽ ഇല്ലെങ്കിലും ഈ taxability ബാധകമാണ്.

points.title: Cost of Acquisition for Gifted Capital Asset
body: Cost of acquisition for property acquired by gift is deemed as cost to the previous owner.
Period of holding includes the period for which the property was held by the previous owner.

highlights.phrase: deemed as cost to the previous owner
includes the period for which the property was held

points.voice_sync_text: Gift ആയി ലഭിച്ച property വിൽക്കുമ്പോൾ Section 49(1) അനുസരിച്ച് cost of acquisition എന്നത് previous owner വാങ്ങിയ വിലയാണ്. Holding period കണക്കാക്കുമ്പോൾ previous owner കൈവശം വെച്ച കാലയളവും കൂട്ടണം.

points.title: Full Value of Consideration under Section 50C
body: If Stamp Duty Value exceeds 110% of actual consideration, Stamp Duty Value is taken as full value of consideration.
Stamp duty charges paid by purchaser can be used to back-calculate the official Stamp Duty Value.

highlights.phrase: Stamp Duty Value is taken as full value

points.voice_sync_text: Section 50C പ്രകാരം Stamp Duty Value എന്നത് actual consideration-ന്റെ 110 percent-നേക്കാൾ കൂടുതലാണെങ്കിൽ, Stamp Duty Value തന്നെ Full Value of Consideration ആയി എടുക്കണം.

points.title: Exemption Criteria & Adjacent Flat Rule
body: Investment in residential house within 1 year before or 2 years after transfer is exempt.
Purchase of two adjacent flats modified into a single residential unit qualifies as one residential house under Section 54.

highlights.phrase: within 1 year before or 2 years after
modified into a single residential unit

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54 പ്രകാരം residential house വിറ്റ് പുതിയ residential house വാങ്ങിയാൽ LTCG Exemption ലഭിക്കും. CIT vs Ananda Basappa വിധി പ്രകാരം, രണ്ട് adjacent flats വാങ്ങി ഒറ്റ residential unit ആയി മാറ്റി ഉപയോഗിച്ചാൽ അത് ഒരു residential house ആയി കണക്കാക്കാം.

points.title: Investment Limit & Date of Payment Benchmark
body: Investment in specified long-term bonds within 6 months from transfer date is exempt up to ₹ 50 Lakhs.
Payment made within 6 months qualifies for Section 54EC exemption even if allotment occurs after 6 months.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 54EC പ്രകാരം Capital Gain സമാഹരിച്ച് 6 മാസത്തിനകം specified bonds-ൽ invest ചെയ്യണം. Hindustan Unilever വിധി പ്രകാരം, 6 മാസത്തിനകം cheque നൽകി payment നടത്തിയാൽ, allotment 6 മാസത്തിന് ശേഷമായാലും Exemption ലഭിക്കും.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Multi-Provision Assessment: House Property & Capital Gains Integration
statutory_assumptions: Illustrative round values used to demonstrate Section 50C valuation, Section 54 adjacent flat benchmark, and Section 54EC bond allotment rules.
Assessee exercises option to opt out of default tax regime under Section 115BAC.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: നമുക്ക് ഈ multi-provision legal mechanics ഒരു സാങ്കൽപ്പിക ഉദാഹരണത്തിലൂടെ വ്യക്തമായി മനസ്സിലാക്കാം.

steps.title: House Property Income Net Determination
steps.voice_sync_text: ആദ്യമായി House Property head നോക്കാം. Rent received 3 Lakhs, municipal tax paid 1 Lakh. Net Annual Value 2 Lakhs. Section 24(a) 30 percent deduction കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ 1.4 Lakhs. Borrowed interest 40,000 കഴിഞ്ഞാൽ Taxable Income 1 Lakh രൂപ വരുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A clean 2.5D visual graphic showing a residential house property with tax icons, showing GAV calculation leading to Net Annual Value with clear deduction tags.

steps.title: Deemed Consideration Check under Section 50C
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇനി property വിൽക്കുമ്പോൾ actual sale consideration 25 Lakhs ആണ്. എന്നാൽ Stamp Duty Value 30 Lakhs ആണ്. SDV actual consideration-ന്റെ 110 percent-ൽ കൂടുതൽ ആയതിനാൽ Section 50C പ്രകാരം Full Value of Consideration 30 Lakhs രൂപ ആയി മാറുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A dual scale mechanism showing 25 Lakhs Actual Consideration on one side and 30 Lakhs Stamp Duty Value on the higher side, highlighting Section 50C statutory override.

calculation_data.formula: Higher of Actual Consideration or SDV (if SDV > 110% of Actual)

steps.title: Application of Section 54 & 54EC Exemptions
steps.voice_sync_text: രണ്ട് adjacent flats വാങ്ങി ഒരൊറ്റ unit ആക്കി മാറ്റിയതിന് Ananda Basappa വിധി പ്രകാരം Section 54 Exemption 15 Lakhs ലഭിക്കും. 6 മാസത്തിനുള്ളിൽ payment നടത്തിയ NHAI bonds-ന് Hindustan Unilever വിധി പ്രകാരം Section 54EC 10 Lakhs ലഭിക്കും. ആകെ Exemption 25 Lakhs.

ch2_q31.doctrine: Taxation of Mutual Funds Capital Gains & Section 54F Exemption Framework

root.title: Mutual Funds Taxation & Section 54F
root.voice_sync_text: Mutual fund redemptions-ൽ Capital Gains tax apply ആകുന്നത് fund-ന്റെ nature, holding period, കൂടാതെ Section 50AA, Section 54F എന്നിവയുടെ statutory provisions അടിസ്ഥാനമാക്കിയാണ്.

points.title: Holding Period & Taxability
body: Equity oriented funds invest at least 65 percent in equity shares of domestic companies.
If held for more than 12 months, it is a Long-Term Capital Asset taxable under Section 112A.
points.voice_sync_text: Domestic companies-ന്റെ equity shares-ൽ at least 65 percent invest ചെയ്യുന്ന funds-നെയാണ് Equity Oriented Funds എന്ന് വിളിക്കുന്നത്. ഇവ 12 months-ൽ കൂടുതൽ hold ചെയ്താൽ Long-Term Capital Asset ആയി മാറും.

points.title: Deemed Short-Term Treatment
body: Specified mutual funds invest not more than 35 percent in domestic equity shares.
If acquired on or after 1st April 2023, gains are treated as deemed short-term capital gains.
points.voice_sync_text: Domestic equity shares-ൽ 35 percent-ൽ കൂടുതൽ investment ഇല്ലാത്ത Specified Mutual Funds 1st April 2023-ന് ശേഷമാണ് acquire ചെയ്തതെങ്കിൽ, holding period എന്തുതന്നെയായാലും Section 50AA പ്രകാരം deemed short-term capital gains ആയിരിക്കും.

points.title: Grandfathered Debt Funds
body: Debt funds acquired before 1st April 2023 are excluded from Section 50AA.
Holding period exceeding threshold classifies the gain as long-term capital gain.
points.voice_sync_text: 1st April 2023-ന് മുമ്പ് acquired ചെയ്ത Debt Mutual Funds-ന് Section 50AA ബാധകമല്ല. അതിനാൽ, ആവശ്യമായ holding period പൂർത്തിയാക്കിയിട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അവ Long-Term Capital Gains ആയി തന്നെ കണക്കാക്കും.

points.title: Proportional Exemption Mechanism
body: Exemption under Section 54F is available exclusively against long-term capital gains.
Calculated proportionately using formula cost of new house divided by net consideration.

highlights.phrase: cost of new house divided by net consideration

points.voice_sync_text: Section 54F exemption ലഭിക്കുന്നത് Long-Term Capital Gains-ന് മാത്രമാണ്. Short-Term Capital Gains-ന് ഇത് ലഭിക്കില്ല. Exemption തുക, Cost of New House divided by Net Consideration എന്ന proportion-ൽ ആണ് calculate ചെയ്യുന്നത്.

steps.image_prompt: A clean 2.5D isometric representation of a digital financial document labeled Section 50AA, showing a red tag for Short-Term Capital Gain on debt investments, soft studio lighting, high resolution 16:9 frame.

steps.voice_sync_text: മറ്റു രണ്ട് funds 1st April 2023-ന് മുമ്പ് വാങ്ങി long term hold ചെയ്തതുകൊണ്ട്, അവയിൽ നിന്ന് ₹ 30 Lakhs Long-Term Capital Gains ഉണ്ടാകുന്നു.

steps.title: Investment in New Residential House u/s 54F
steps.voice_sync_text: ഈ net consideration തുക ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഒരു residential house വാങ്ങുമ്പോൾ, Section 54F പ്രകാരം exemption claim ചെയ്യാം.
steps.image_prompt: Architectural rendering of a modern luxury residential villa in isometric view, wrapped with glowing blue statutory checkmarks representing Section 54F compliance.

steps.title: Proportional Exemption Computation
steps.voice_sync_text: Section 54F proportional formula apply ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ, eligible LTCG യിൽ നിന്ന് exemption കുറച്ച് ബാക്കി തുക മാത്രം taxable LTCG ആയി മാറുന്നു.

ch2_q32.doctrine: Section 54G: Shifting of Industrial Undertaking from Urban to Non-Urban Area

root.title: Section 54G Industrial Shifting Exemption
root.voice_sync_text: Section 54G പ്രകാരം an industrial undertaking urban area-ൽ നിന്ന് non-urban area-ലേക്ക് shift ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ ലഭിക്കുന്ന Capital Gains Exemption-ന്റെ legal principles നമ്മൾ ഇപ്പോൾ പഠിക്കുകയാണ്.

points.title: Qualifying Capital Assets
body: Exemption applies to transfer of plant, machinery, land, building, or rights in land or building used for the undertaking.
Acquisition of new plant, machinery, land, or building in the non-urban area qualifies for exemption.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 54G പ്രകാരം industrial undertaking-ൽ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്ന plant, machinery, land, building എന്നിവ transfer ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ വരുന്ന capital gain-നാണ് exemption ലഭിക്കുന്നത്.

points.title: Furniture Statutory Exclusion
body: Capital gains on transfer of furniture do not qualify for exemption under Section 54G.
Cost of new furniture purchased in non-urban area cannot be claimed as Section 54G exemption.

highlights.phrase: furniture do not qualify for exemption

points.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ വളരെ പ്രധാനം, furniture transfers അല്ലെങ്കിൽ പുതിയ furniture purchase എന്നിവയ്‌ക്ക് Section 54G exemption ലഭിക്കില്ല.

points.title: Reinvestment Time Limits
body: New eligible assets must be acquired within 1 year before or 3 years after the date of transfer.
Covers cost of purchasing new assets, constructing buildings, and shifting existing assets and establishment.
points.voice_sync_text: Capital asset transfer ചെയ്യുന്ന തീയതിക്ക് 1 year before അല്ലെങ്കിൽ 3 years after എന്ന സമയപരിധിക്കുള്ളിൽ പുതിയ assets വാങ്ങുകയോ construct ചെയ്യുകയോ വേണം.

points.title: Deemed Short-Term Capital Gains
body: Transfer of depreciable assets results in deemed Short-Term Capital Gains u/s 50.
Written Down Value (WDV) of the block of assets is treated as deemed Cost of Acquisition.
points.voice_sync_text: Depreciable assets transfer ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ Section 50 പ്രകാരം WDV cost of acquisition ആയി കണക്കാക്കി Short-Term Capital Gain ആണ് ലഭിക്കുക.

points.title: Priority Allocation against STCG
body: Exemption u/s 54G should be first set off against STCG as STCG bears higher tax burden.
Balance unadjusted exemption is set off against LTCG arising from non-depreciable assets like land.
points.voice_sync_text: Assessee-ക്ക് ലഭിക്കുന്ന Section 54G exemption ആദ്യം higher tax rate ഉള്ള STCG-ക്ക് എതിരെയും, ബാക്കിയുള്ളത് LTCG-ക്ക് എതിരെയും set off ചെയ്യാവുന്നതാണ്.

statutory_assumptions: Assessee shifts industrial undertaking from urban to non-urban area.
Eligible STCG on depreciable plant u/s 50 = ₹ 20 Lakhs; Eligible LTCG on land = ₹ 10 Lakhs.
Total reinvestment in eligible new plant and building = ₹ 25 Lakhs.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി Section 54G-ലെ priority set-off mechanics എങ്ങനെ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു എന്ന് ഒരു simple numerical illustration വഴി നോക്കാം.

steps.title: Determination of Capital Gains by Asset Category
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ depreciable assets transfer ചെയ്തപ്പോൾ ₹ 20 Lakhs Short-Term Capital Gain-ഉം, land transfer ചെയ്തപ്പോൾ ₹ 10 Lakhs Long-Term Capital Gain-ഉം ലഭിക്കുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A modern industrial factory in an urban center being dismantled, with moving trucks carrying machinery towards a scenic green countryside, 2.5D isometric view, cinematic daylight.

steps.title: Reinvestment in New Industrial Assets u/s 54G
steps.voice_sync_text: Assessee non-urban area-ൽ പുതിയ plant, machinery, land എന്നിവയ്ക്കായി ₹ 25 Lakhs reinvest ചെയ്യുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: A brand new eco-friendly factory building being erected in a non-urban rural landscape with heavy crane equipment, 2.5D isometric visual.

steps.title: Priority Set-off Allocation u/s 54G
steps.voice_sync_text: ധനലാഭമുള്ള രീതിയിൽ ₹ 25 Lakhs exemption ആദ്യം ₹ 20 Lakhs STCG-ക്ക് എതിരെ fully exhaust ചെയ്യുന്നു. ബാക്കി ₹ 5 Lakhs LTCG-ക്ക് എതിരെ adjust ചെയ്യുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: Tax balance visual showing ₹ 20 Lakhs STCG fully neutralized to zero by Section 54G shield, leaving remaining shield for LTCG, 3D graphic financial chart.

calculation_data.formula: STCG (₹ 20L) - Exemption (₹ 20L) = Nil STCG; LTCG (₹ 10L) - Exemption (₹ 5L) = ₹ 5L Taxable LTCG

root.title: Section 112A & Grandfathering Valuation
root.voice_sync_text: Section 112A പ്രകാരം Long Term Capital Asset-കളുടെ Transfer-ൽ വരുന്ന Capital Gains Tax Rules-ഉം, 1st February 2018-ന് മുമ്പ് വാങ്ങിയ Assets-ന്റെ Grandfathering Cost of Acquisition-ഉം നമുക്ക് വിശദമായി പഠിക്കാം.

points.title: Tax Rate and Threshold
body: Taxable at 12.5% on Long Term Capital Gains exceeding ₹ 1,25,000 in a Financial Year.
Applicable to listed equity shares and units of equity-oriented funds subject to STT payment conditions.

highlights.phrase: 12.5% on Long Term Capital Gains exceeding ₹ 1,25,000
units of equity-oriented funds subject to STT payment conditions

points.voice_sync_text: Section 112A അനുസരിച്ച്, ഒരു Financial Year-ൽ ₹ 1,25,000-ന് മുകളിലുള്ള Long Term Capital Gains-ന് 12.5% ആണ് Tax Rate. Equity shares-നും Equity Oriented Fund units-നും STT payment conditions ബാധകമാണ്.

points.title: Cost of Acquisition Computation
body: Cost of Acquisition is Higher of Actual Cost OR Lower of FMV on 31st January 2018 and Full Value of Consideration.
This grandfathering formula protects capital gains accrued prior to 1st February 2018 from tax.

highlights.phrase: Higher of Actual Cost OR Lower of FMV on 31st January 2018 and Full Value of Consideration
protects capital gains accrued prior to 1st February 2018

points.voice_sync_text: 1st February 2018-ന് മുമ്പ് അക്വയർ ചെയ്ത Assets-ന്റെ Cost of Acquisition കണ്ടുപിടിക്കാൻ Grandfathering Formula ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു. Actual Cost അല്ലെങ്കിൽ FMV on 31st January 2018 and Sale Consideration-ലെ Lower Amount - ഇവയിൽ ഏതാണോ Higher, അതാണ് Cost of Acquisition.

points.title: Listed vs Unlisted Asset FMV
body: For assets listed on 31st January 2018, FMV is the highest trading price quoted on a recognized stock exchange on that date.
For unlisted units or assets not listed on 31st January 2018, FMV is the Net Asset Value (NAV) as on 31st January 2018.

highlights.phrase: highest trading price quoted on a recognized stock exchange
Net Asset Value (NAV) as on 31st January 2018

points.voice_sync_text: 31st January 2018-ൽ Listed ആയ Assets-ന് stock exchange-ലെ Highest Trading Price ആണ് FMV. എന്നാൽ 31st January 2018-ൽ Unlisted ആയ Units-ന് 31st January 2018-ലെ Net Asset Value അതായത് NAV ആണ് FMV ആയി എടുക്കേണ്ടത്.

statutory_assumptions: Asset acquired prior to 1st February 2018
STT paid at time of transfer as per Section 112A requirements
Exemption threshold of ₹ 1,25,000 applies to total LTCG

slides.title: Core Tax Framework u/s 112A
slides.subtitle: Scope, Rate, and Exemption Threshold
slides.voice_sync_text: Section 112A പ്രകാരം Specified Financial Assets-ന്റെ Long Term Capital Gains-ന് 12.5% Tax Rate ആണ് ബാധകം. ആകെ LTCG-യിൽ ആദ്യത്തെ ₹ 1,25,000 രൂപ തികച്ചും Exempted ആണ്.

cards.heading: Applicable Tax Rate
points: Taxed at concessional rate of 12.5% plus applicable Health and Education Cess.
No indexation benefit allowed under the proviso to Section 48.

cards.heading: Exemption Threshold
points: Aggregate LTCG under Section 112A up to ₹ 1,25,000 per financial year is exempt.
Tax is payable exclusively on the amount exceeding ₹ 1,25,000.

slides.title: Grandfathering Cost Determination
slides.subtitle: Assets Acquired Prior to 1st February 2018
slides.voice_sync_text: 1st February 2018-ന് മുമ്പ് വാങ്ങിയ Assets-ന്റെ Cost of Acquisition കണ്ടുപിടിക്കുന്ന രീതി ഇവിടെ കാണാം. Actual Cost-ഉം, FMV and Sale Price-ലെ Lower Value-ഉം തമ്മിൽ Compare ചെയ്ത് Higher Value സ്വീകരിക്കുന്നു.

cards.heading: Step 1: Lower Comparison
points: Determine Lower of: (i) Fair Market Value as on 31st January 2018, and (ii) Full Value of Consideration.

cards.heading: Step 2: Final Cost Selection
points: Cost of Acquisition = Higher of: (i) Actual Cost of Acquisition, and (ii) Step 1 Result.

slides.title: FMV Determination Benchmark Rules
slides.subtitle: Listed vs Unlisted Assets as on 31st January 2018
slides.voice_sync_text: 31st January 2018-ലെ Listing status ആണ് FMV തീരുമാനിക്കുന്നത്. Listed ആണെങ്കിൽ Highest Trading Price-ഉം, Unlisted ആണെങ്കിൽ Net Asset Value-ഉം ആണ് Benchmark.

cards.heading: Listed on 31.01.2018
points: FMV = Highest price quoted on a recognized stock exchange on 31st January 2018.

cards.heading: Unlisted on 31.01.2018
points: FMV = Net Asset Value (NAV) of the unit/share as on 31st January 2018.

trap_data.trap_description: If units were unlisted on 31st January 2018 but listed later, DO NOT use the trading price on the subsequent listing date. You must strictly use the NAV as on 31st January 2018.

ch3_q3.doctrine: Section 32 Depreciation Allowance & Block of Assets

root.title: Section 32 Depreciation Allowance
root.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ നമ്മൾ Section 32 പ്രകാരമുള്ള Depreciation allowance ഉം Written Down Value computation ഉം ആണ് പഠിക്കുന്നത്. Let's look at the statutory rules for block of assets.

points.title: Put to Use Requirement
body: Asset must be owned by the assessee and used for the purpose of business or profession.
If an asset is acquired and put to use for less than 180 days in the year of acquisition, depreciation is restricted to 50% of the normal rate.

highlights.phrase: used for the purpose of business
restricted to 50% of the normal rate

points.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ asset business-ൽ put to use ചെയ്തിരിക്കണം. acquisition ചെയ്ത വർഷത്തിൽ 180 ദിവസത്തിൽ குறைவாகയാണ് ഉപയോഗിച്ചതെങ്കിൽ, normal depreciation-ന്റെ പകുതി മാത്രമേ അനുവദിക്കുകയുള്ളൂ.

branches.branch_title: Depreciation Rates for Plant & Machinery Blocks

points.title: General Machinery & Windmills
body: General Plant and Machinery falls under the 15% depreciation block.
Windmills and specially designed devices running on windmills installed on or after 1st April 2014 are eligible for 40% depreciation.
points.voice_sync_text: General Plant and Machinery 15% block-ൽ വരുന്നു. അതുപോലെ Windmills പോലുള്ള പ്രത്യേക devices-ന് 40% depreciation rate ആണ് ബാധകമായിട്ടുള്ളത്.

points.title: Eligibility and Rates
body: Additional depreciation @ 20% is available for new plant and machinery installed in manufacturing undertakings.
If put to use for less than 180 days, additional depreciation is restricted to 10% (50% of 20%).
points.voice_sync_text: Manufacturing undertakings-ൽ പുതിയ plant and machinery install ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ 20% additional depreciation ലഭിക്കും. 180 ദിവസത്തിൽ குறைவாகയാണ് put to use ചെയ്തതെങ്കിൽ അത് 10% ആയി കുറയും.

points.title: Closing WDV Formula
body: WDV at the beginning plus actual cost of assets acquired during the year, less moneys payable in respect of assets sold or discarded.
Total depreciation (normal plus additional) for the year is deducted from the block to arrive at the closing WDV as on 1st April.
points.voice_sync_text: ഓരോ block-ന്റെയും WDV കണക്കാക്കുമ്പോൾ opening WDV-യോടൊപ്പം പുതിയ additions കൂട്ടി, sales deductions കുറച്ചതിന് ശേഷമാണ് depreciation charge ചെയ്യുന്നത്.

statutory_assumptions: Company is engaged in manufacturing with eligible new machinery additions.
Additions are bifurcated based on the 180-day put-to-use threshold rule.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി ഒരു simple example വഴി depreciation calculation എങ്ങനെയാണെന്ന് നോക്കാം.

steps.title: Acquisition of New Machinery
steps.voice_sync_text: ആദ്യം കമ്പനി പുതിയ machinery acquire ചെയ്ത് 180 ദിവസത്തിൽ കൂടുതൽ put to use ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ full depreciation rate ബാധകമാകുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: Cinematic 2.5D isometric view of a modern textile manufacturing plant with heavy industrial machinery, dramatic studio lighting.

steps.title: Application of 180-Day Rule
steps.voice_sync_text: 180 ദിവസത്തിൽ குறைவாக put to use ചെയ്ത assets-ന് normal depreciation-ഉം additional depreciation-ഉം 50% ആയി restricted ചെയ്യപ്പെടുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: Cinematic 2.5D isometric view of factory warehouse with fork-lift trucks and industrial goods, clean corporate lighting.

steps.title: Closing WDV Computation
steps.voice_sync_text: അവസാനമായി normal depreciation ഉം additional depreciation ഉം കുറച്ച് അടുത്ത financial year-ലേക്കുള്ള closing WDV കണക്കാക്കുന്നു.
steps.image_prompt: Cinematic 2.5D isometric view of financial audit ledger and digital tax calculation screens, professional corporate aesthetic.

explainer_presentation.title: Section 32 Depreciation Allowance & Block of Assets

slides.title: Core Conditions for Depreciation u/s 32
slides.subtitle: Statutory Prerequisites
slides.voice_sync_text: Section 32 പ്രകാരം depreciation ലഭിക്കണമെങ്കിൽ asset assessee-യുടെ ownership-ൽ ആയിരിക്കണം കൂടാതെ business-നായി put to use ചെയ്തിരിക്കുകയും വേണം.

cards.heading: Ownership & Usage
points: Asset must be owned wholly or partly by the assessee.
Asset must be used for the purpose of business or profession during the previous year.

slides.title: The 180-Day Threshold Rule
slides.subtitle: Timing of Put-to-Use
slides.voice_sync_text: acquisition ചെയ്ത വർഷത്തിൽ asset 180 ദിവസത്തിൽ കുറവാണ് ഉപയോഗിച്ചതെങ്കിൽ depreciation സാധാരണ നിരക്കിന്റെ പകുതിയായി restricted ചെയ്യും.

cards.heading: Restriction Rule
points: If asset is put to use for less than 180 days, normal and additional depreciation are restricted to 50%.
Assets not put to use at all during the year earn zero depreciation for that assessment year.

root.title: Agricultural Income & PGBP Apportionment
root.voice_sync_text: ഈ ലെക്ചറിൽ നമ്മൾ Income Tax Act-ലെ കാർഷിക വരുമാനവുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട നിയമങ്ങളാണ് ചർച്ച ചെയ്യുന്നത്. എങ്ങനെയാണ് ഒരു അഗ്രികൾച്ചറൽ പ്രൊഡ്യൂസ് ബിസിനസ്സ് ആവശ്യങ്ങൾക്കായി ഉപയോഗിക്കുമ്പോൾ അതിന്റെ വരുമാനത്തെ Agricultural Income എന്നും Business Income എന്നും തരംതിരിക്കുന്നത് എന്ന് നമുക്ക് നോക്കാം.

points.title: Nursery Income Rule
body: Income derived from saplings or seedlings grown in a nursery.
Deemed to be agricultural income even if basic operations are not performed on land.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 2(1A)-ന്റെ Explanation 3 പ്രകാരം, നഴ്സറികളിൽ വളർത്തുന്ന തൈകളിൽ നിന്നുള്ള വരുമാനം പൂർണ്ണമായും കാർഷിക വരുമാനമായിട്ടാണ് കണക്കാക്കുന്നത്. ഇതിന് ലാൻഡ് ഓപ്പറേഷൻസ് വേണമെന്ന നിർബന്ധമില്ല എന്നത് പ്രത്യേകം ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുക.

points.title: Manufacturing Apportionment
body: Tea, Coffee, and Rubber involve complex processing.
Specific rules mandate the split between agricultural and business income.

highlights.phrase: split between agricultural and business income

points.voice_sync_text: టీ, റബ്ബർ, കാപ്പി എന്നിവയുടെ പ്രോസസിങ് നടക്കുമ്പോൾ ടോട്ടൽ ഇൻകത്തെ കൃത്യമായി അഗ്രികൾച്ചറൽ ഇൻകം എന്നും ബിസിനസ് ഇൻകം എന്നും സ്പ്ലിറ്റ് ചെയ്യണം. ഓരോന്നിനും നിയമത്തിൽ പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്ന ഫിക്സഡ് പെർസെന്റേജ് അനുസരിച്ചാണ് ഈ കണക്കുകൂട്ടൽ.

points.title: Non-Indian Produce
body: Apportionment rules do not apply to produce grown outside India.
Total income is fully taxable as business income under PGBP.
points.voice_sync_text: ഒരു കാര്യം കൂടി ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുക, ഇന്ത്യയ്ക്ക് പുറത്ത് കൃഷി ചെയ്യുന്ന ഉൽപ്പന്നങ്ങളുടെ കാര്യത്തിൽ ഈ അപ്പോർഷൻമെന്റ് റൂളുകൾ ബാധകമല്ല. അത്തരം സന്ദർഭങ്ങളിൽ പൂർണ്ണ വരുമാനവും ബിസിനസ് വരുമാനമായിട്ടാണ് ടാക്സ് ചെയ്യുക.

statutory_assumptions: Income from Indian Tea plantation ₹ 10 Lakhs
Income from Foreign Coffee plantation ₹ 5 Lakhs
concept_simulation.intro_voice: നമുക്ക് ഒരു സിമ്പിൾ എക്സാമ്പിൾ വെച്ച് ഈ രണ്ട് അവസ്ഥകളും ഒന്ന് നോക്കാം.

steps.title: Indian Tea Income (Rule 8)
steps.voice_sync_text: ഇന്ത്യയിൽ വളർത്തിയ ടീയുടെ കാര്യത്തിൽ, 60% കാർഷിക വരുമാനമായും 40% ബിസിനസ് വരുമാനമായും നമ്മൾ പിരിക്കുന്നു. അതായത് 6 ലക്ഷം എക്സെംപ്റ്റ് ആകും.

steps.title: Foreign Coffee Income
steps.voice_sync_text: എന്നാൽ വിദേശത്ത് കൃഷി ചെയ്ത കാപ്പിയുടെ കാര്യത്തിൽ, മുഴുവൻ 5 ലക്ഷം രൂപയും ബിസിനസ് ഇൻകം ആയിട്ട് തന്നെ ടാക്സബിൾ ആണ്.

ch3_q22.doctrine: Maintenance of Books of Accounts under Section 44AA

root.title: Maintenance of Books of Accounts
root.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ നമ്മൾ പഠിക്കുന്നത് Section 44AA ഉം Rule 6F ഉം പ്രകാരം ഒരു profession അല്ലെങ്കിൽ business ചെയ്യുന്ന ആൾ compulsory ആയി books of accounts maintain ചെയ്യേണ്ട നിയമങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചാണ്.

points.title: Mandatory Maintenance for Notified Professions
body: Section 44AA(1) requires every person carrying on any profession notified by the Board in the Official Gazette to maintain such books of account.
Rule 6F specifies the exact books of accounts and documents required to be maintained by notified professionals.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 44AA(1) അനുസരിച്ച്, Central Board notified ആയ professions ചെയ്യുന്നവർ ആദായനികുതി കണക്കാക്കാൻ സഹായിക്കുന്ന books of accounts നിർബന്ധമായും maintain ചെയ്യണം.

points.title: Gross Receipts Threshold Tests
body: Gross receipts in all the three years immediately preceding the relevant previous year has exceeded ₹ 1,50,000.
For a new profession set up in the relevant previous year, gross receipts are likely to exceed ₹ 1,50,000 in that previous year.

highlights.phrase: all the three years immediately preceding

points.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ ഏറ്റവും പ്രധാനം threshold limit ആണ്. കഴിഞ്ഞ മൂന്ന് വർഷങ്ങളിലും gross receipts ഒന്നര ലക്ഷം രൂപയിൽക്കൂടുതൽ ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കണം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ പുതിയ profession ആണെങ്കിൽ ആ വർഷം കവിയാൻ സാധ്യത ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കണം.

concept_simulation.doctrine_topic: Maintenance of Books of Accounts u/s 44AA
statutory_assumptions: Assessee is carrying on a notified profession such as film artist.
Gross receipts for the preceding three financial years are evaluated against the statutory threshold of ₹ 1,50,000.
concept_simulation.intro_voice: ഇനി ഒരു simple example വഴി Section 44AA ലെ threshold conditions പരിശോധിക്കാം.

steps.title: Notified Profession Status
steps.voice_sync_text: ആദ്യം വ്യക്തി ചെയ്യുന്ന profession notified profession ആണോ എന്ന് പരിശോധിക്കണം. Film artist എന്നത് ഒരു notified profession ആണ്.
steps.image_prompt: Cinematic 2.5D isometric view of a film artist studio with professional lighting, digital camera, and script boards.

steps.title: Three-Year Gross Receipts Review
steps.voice_sync_text: അടുത്തതായി കഴിഞ്ഞ മൂന്ന് വർഷങ്ങളിലെ gross receipts പരിശോധിക്കുമ്പോൾ, എല്ലാ വർഷവും ഒന്നര ലക്ഷം രൂപ കവിഞ്ഞിട്ടുണ്ടോ എന്ന് നോക്കണം.
steps.image_prompt: Cinematic 2.5D isometric view of financial ledgers and bar charts showing gross receipt thresholds over three years.

steps.title: Statutory Obligation Determination
steps.voice_sync_text: കഴിഞ്ഞ വർഷങ്ങളിൽ gross receipts ഒന്നര ലക്ഷം രൂപ കവിയാത്ത പക്ഷം, Rule 6F പ്രകാരമുള്ള കർശനമായ books of accounts maintain ചെയ്യേണ്ട ബാധ്യത ബാധകമല്ല.
steps.image_prompt: Cinematic 2.5D isometric view of a modern tax consultant office with legal books and a glowing compliance checklist.

root.title: Taxation of Partnership Firms
root.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ നമ്മൾ partnership firm-ന്റെ total income compute ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ apply ആകുന്ന legal provisions ആണ് examine ചെയ്യുന്നത്. Section 40(b)-ഉം Section 40A(3)-ഉം strict ಆಗി apply ചെയ്യണം.

points.title: Interest to Partners Limit
body: Simple interest paid to partners is allowed up to a maximum rate of 12 percent per annum.
Authorization in the partnership deed for the period of payment is mandatory for allowance.

highlights.phrase: maximum rate of 12 percent per annum

points.voice_sync_text: Section 40(b)(iv) പ്രകാരം partners-ന് നൽകുന്ന interest 12 percent per annum-ൽ കവിയാൻ പാടില്ല. Deed-ൽ authorize ചെയ്തിരിക്കുന്ന period മാത്രം ആണ് allow ചെയ്യുന്നത്.

points.title: Remuneration to Working Partners
body: Remuneration is restricted to working partners based on statutory book profit slabs.
Judicial precedents confirm partners in representative capacity are also subject to these limits.

rows: ₹ 1,50,000 or 90% of book profit, whichever is more

points.voice_sync_text: Working partners-ന് നൽകുന്ന remuneration Section 40(b)(v) book profit slabs-ന് ഉള്ളിൽ restricted ആണ്. Representative capacity-യിൽ ഉള്ള partner ആണെങ്കിലും ഈ limit ബാധകമാണ്.

points.title: Cash Expenditure Disallowance
body: Aggregate cash payments exceeding ₹ 10,000 to a single person in a single day are disallowed.
100 percent of such expenditure is added back to business profits.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 40A(3) പ്രകാരം ഒരു দিনে ഒരു വ്യക്തിക്ക് നൽകുന്ന cash payment 10,000 രൂപയിൽ കൂടുതൽ ആണെങ്കിൽ ആ തുക മുഴുവൻ disallow ചെയ്യപ്പെടും.

points.title: Actuarial Gratuity Provision
body: Mere provisions for gratuity based on actuarial valuation are not allowable deductions.
Only actual gratuity paid during the previous year qualifies for deduction.
points.voice_sync_text: Actuarial valuation-ന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിൽ books-ൽ create ചെയ്യുന്ന gratuity provision allowable അല്ല. Actual ആയി pay ചെയ്ത gratuity മാത്രമേ deduction ആയി claim ചെയ്യാൻ പറ്റൂ.

points.title: Interest on Income-Tax Refund
body: Interest received on income-tax refunds does not form part of business profits.
Such interest is strictly taxable under Income from Other Sources.

highlights.phrase: does not form part of business profits
taxable under Income from Other Sources

points.voice_sync_text: Income-tax refund-ന് ലഭിക്കുന്ന interest business income ആയി treat ചെയ്യാൻ പാടില്ല. അത് strictly Income from Other Sources-ൽ ആണ് taxable ആകുന്നത്.

statutory_assumptions: Net profit before adjustments is assumed as ₹ 10,00,000
Interest and remuneration adjustments are made as per Section 40(b)

ch3_q36.doctrine: Comprehensive PGBP Adjustments and Statutory Disallowances

root.title: Comprehensive PGBP Statutory Rules
root.badge: Sec 32 · Sec 40(a)(i) · Sec 40A(7) · ICDS II & IX
root.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ നമ്മൾ PGBP അണ്ടറിലുള്ള വിവിധ statutory provisions ആണ് പഠിക്കുന്നത്. ICDS valuation മുതൽ Section 40A(7) Gratuity disallowance ഉം Section 40(a)(i) TDS non-deposit penalties വരെയുള്ള നിയമങ്ങൾ നോക്കാം.

branches.branch_title: Inventory Valuation under ICDS II & IX

points.title: Borrowing Cost in Inventory Valuation
body: Interest cost shall not be included in inventory valuation unless meeting ICDS IX criteria.
Qualifying assets require a period of twelve months or more to reach saleable condition.

highlights.phrase: Interest cost shall not be included

points.voice_sync_text: ICDS II അനുസരിച്ച്, inventory valuation-ൽ interest cost ഉൾപ്പെടുത്താൻ പാടില്ല. ICDS IX പ്രകാരം qualifying asset-ന് 12 മാസത്തിൽ കൂടുതൽ സമയം എങ്കിൽ മാത്രമേ borrowing cost capitalize ചെയ്യാൻ പാടുള്ളൂ.

points.title: Actuarial Provision vs Actual Payment
body: Provision based on actuarial valuation is strictly disallowed under section 40A(7).
Actual gratuity paid during the previous year is allowed as a business deduction.

highlights.phrase: Provision based on actuarial valuation is strictly disallowed

points.voice_sync_text: Section 40A(7) പ്രകാരം actuarial valuation അടിസ്ഥാനമാക്കിയുള്ള gratuity provision അനുവദനീയമല്ല. എന്നാൽ യഥാർത്ഥത്തിൽ നൽകിയ actual gratuity payment business deduction ആയി അനുവദിക്കും.

points.title: Franchise Fees Capitalization
body: One-time franchise fees paid to acquire franchise rights is a capital intangible asset.
Eligible for statutory depreciation under section 32 at the prescribed block rate.
points.voice_sync_text: ഒരു ബിസിനസിനായി നൽകുന്ന one-time franchise fees ഒരു intangible asset ആണ്. Section 32 പ്രകാരം ഇത് capitalized ചെയ്ത് depreciation ക്ലെയിം ചെയ്യാൻ അർഹതയുണ്ട്.

points.title: Loss of Cash in Transit
body: Loss from theft or dacoity is deductible if it is incidental to business operations.
Cash loss during transit from bank to administrative office is a normal business risk.
points.voice_sync_text: ബിസിനസ് നടത്തിപ്പിനിടയിൽ ഉണ്ടാകുന്ന cash theft അല്ലെങ്കിൽ loss in transit എന്നത് incidental to business ആയതുകൊണ്ട് revenue expenditure ആയി പൂർണ്ണമായും അനുവദനീയമാണ്.

points.title: Royalty TDS Default Disallowance
body: Royalty paid to a non-resident subject to TDS u/s 195 requires timely deposit.
Failure to deposit tax before the due date of filing return triggers 100% disallowance.
points.voice_sync_text: Section 40(a)(i) പ്രകാരം non-resident-ന് നൽകുന്ന Royalty-ക്ക് TDS deduct ചെയ്ത് مقرر തിയ്യതിക്ക് മുൻപ് അടച്ചില്ലെങ്കിൽ, ആ തുക മുഴുവൻ PGBP-യിൽ disallow ചെയ്യപ്പെടും.

statutory_assumptions: Net profit as per profit and loss account is taken as the baseline.
Statutory adjustments are made for provisions, intangibles, and TDS defaults.

root.title: PGBP Statutory Adjustments Framework
root.voice_sync_text: ഇവിടെ നമ്മൾ PGBP അണ്ടറിലെ വിവിധ statutory provisions അതായത് Section 40A(2), Section 40A(3), Section 36(1)(ix), പിന്നെ Section 2(22)(e) deemed dividend എന്നിവയുടെ legal rules ആണ് പഠിക്കുന്നത്.

branches.branch_title: Payments to Specified Persons & Cash Limits

points.title: Excess Payment Disallowance
body: Payments made to specified persons exceeding Fair Market Value are disallowed under Section 40A(2).
Cash payments exceeding ten thousand rupees per day attract complete disallowance under Section 40A(3).

highlights.phrase: specified persons exceeding Fair Market Value

points.voice_sync_text: Section 40A(2) പ്രകാരം specified persons-ന് കൊടുക്കുന്ന തുക fair market value-നേക്കാൾ കൂടുതൽ ആണെങ്കിൽ ആ excess amount disallow ചെയ്യും. അതുപോലെ Section 40A(3) പ്രകാരം പതിനായിരം രൂപയിൽ കൂടുതൽ cash കൊടുക്കുകയാണെങ്കിൽ അതും disallow ചെയ്യപ്പെടും.

points.title: Amortization of Capital Expenditure
body: Capital expenditure incurred by a company for promoting family planning amongst its employees is deductible.
The deduction is spread equally over five successive years, with four-fifths added back if fully debited.

highlights.phrase: promoting family planning amongst its employees
spread equally over five successive years

points.voice_sync_text: Section 36(1)(ix) പ്രകാരം ജീവനക്കാർക്കിടയിൽ family planning പ്രോത്സാഹിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള capital expenditure അഞ്ച് വർഷങ്ങളിലായിട്ടാണ് deduct ചെയ്യാൻ അനുവദിക്കുന്നത്. അതിനാൽ മുഴുവൻ തുകയും P and L അക്കൗണ്ടിൽ debit ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ 4/5th തുക add back ചെയ്യണം.

points.title: Loan to Substantial Shareholder
body: Any payment by a closely held company of any sum by way of advance or loan to a shareholder holding ten percent or more voting power is deemed dividend.
Taxation is restricted to the extent of accumulated profits possessed by the company on the date of the loan.

highlights.phrase: advance or loan to a shareholder

points.voice_sync_text: Section 2(22)(e) പ്രകാരം ഒരു closely held company തന്റെ shareholder-ന് നൽകുന്ന loan അല്ലെങ്കിൽ advance, accumulated profits-ന്റെ പരിധിയിൽ നിന്ന് deemed dividend ആയി tax ചെയ്യപ്പെടും.

dt-c1-q1.context_pill: Section 4 & 28: Diversion vs Application of Income

beats.voice_sync_text: Nammude assessee Mr. Bhargava, Supreme Court-il oru company-kku vendi appear cheyyan ₹ 5,00,000 fee negotiate cheythu. Pakshe condition: ee amount ayal create cheyyunna oru public charitable trust-ilekku povanam. Section 4 charging principles prakaram ithu Diversion of Income aano atho mere Application of Income aano?

quote_box.statute: Section 4 vs Section 28(i) of Income-tax Act, 1961
quote_box.text: Whether professional fees received subject to a self-imposed obligation to transfer the funds to a charitable trust constitutes Diversion by Overriding Title or taxable Application of Professional Income?
quote_box.highlight: Diversion by Overriding Title or taxable Application of Professional Income

beats.voice_sync_text: Ivide legal characterization check cheyyan Income Tax-il randu paths und. Superior legal title vazhi income assessee-kku kittunnathinu mumbey divert aayal ath Diversion of Income aanu, non-taxable. Ennal income assess-kku reach cheytha sesham, assessee-yude voluntary act vazhi mathram transfer cheythal ath Application of Income aayi maarum.

Landmark precedent Supreme Court-inte CIT v. Sitaldas Tirathdas aanu. Ee judgment-il Supreme Court theerth paranju: Income source-il ninnum assessee-yude adukkal ethunnathinu mumbey legal title vazhi divert cheythal mathrame exclusion kittu. Bhargava-yude case-il, client alla trust create cheythathu, client-inu obligation onnum illayirunnu. Obligation create cheythathu Mr. Bhargava thanneyanu.

ratio_box.verdict: Does the amount reach the assessee first as his own income and then applied? If yes, it is an Application of Income. A self-imposed obligation by the recipient does NOT create an overriding title.

beats.voice_sync_text: Ini namukk Mr. Bhargava-yude Assessment Year computation nokkam. Company nalkiya ₹ 5,00,000 ayalude Professional Receipts aanu. Ayal trust execute cheythu transfer cheythathu mere post-receipt application mathramayanu. So full ₹ 5,00,000 PGBP head-il assessable aakum.

ledger_rows.desc: Less: Claim of Diversion by Overriding Title

beats.voice_sync_text: CA Final exam point of view-il ee 3 Golden Rules eppozhum orkuka. Rule 1: Source of obligation check cheyyuka. Rule 2: Stage of interception examine cheyyuka. Rule 3: Self-imposed trusts are always Application of Income, taxable under PGBP.

rules.exp: Overriding title exists only if an external superior law, court decree, or payer creates the obligation before income reaches the assessee.
Diversion occurs at the source (interception). Applying funds after earning title or receipt is mere destination (application).
A professional directing clients to pay fees into their own trust is fully taxable under Section 28 as PGBP; Chapter VI-A (Section 80G) can only be explored separately.

beats.voice_sync_text: സെക്ഷൻ 51-ന്റെ പ്രൊവിഷൻ മനസ്സിലാക്കാൻ നമുക്ക് ഹരിയുടെ ഒരു സിമ്പിൾ എക്സാമ്പിൾ നോക്കാം. ഹരി 2002-ൽ 9 ലക്ഷം രൂപയ്ക്ക് ഡൽഹിയിൽ ഒരു റെസിഡൻഷ്യൽ ഹൗസ് വാങ്ങി. 2005 മെയ് മാസത്തിൽ പരി എന്ന ബയറുമായി നെഗോഷ്യേഷൻ നടത്തുമ്പോൾ 25,000 രൂപ അഡ്വാൻസ് മണി വാങ്ങി. പക്ഷെ പിന്നീട് ആ ഡീൽ കാൻസലാവുകയും ഹരി ആ അഡ്വാൻസ് ഫോർഫീറ്റ് ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്തു. ഇവിടെ ഒരു കട്ട്-ഓഫ് ഡേറ്റ് ഓർക്കുക: ഒന്നാം തീയതി ഏപ്രിൽ 2014-ന് മുൻപാണ് ഫോർഫീച്ചർ എങ്കിൽ, സെക്ഷൻ 51 പ്രകാരം അത് കോസ്റ്റ് ഓഫ് അക്വിസിഷനിൽ നിന്ന് കുറയ്ക്കണം! അതുകൊണ്ട് ഹരിയുടെ അഡ്ജസ്റ്റഡ് കോസ്റ്റ് 9 ലക്ഷത്തിൽ നിന്ന് 25,000 കുറച്ച് 8 ലക്ഷത്തി 75,000 രൂപയായി മാറുന്നു!

dt-c2-q34.context_pill: Capital Gains | Real Estate Taxation & Section 112

title.text: Property Transfer: Stamp Duty Benchmark vs Actual Agreement

beats.voice_sync_text: Priypetta vidyarthikale, nammude case-ile assessee Mr. Vijay aanu. Vijay 1982-il oru residential house purchase cheythu, total cost ₹ 5,00,000. Ee property 1st April 2001-il Fair Market Value ₹ 15,00,000 aayirunnu, pakshe Stamp Duty Value ₹ 14,00,000 maathram. Ee asset-il randu thavana advance money forfeit cheythittundu: Onnamathathu June 2009-il ₹ 1,50,000, randamathathu July 2016-il ₹ 2,00,000. Pineed September 2015-il first floor construct cheythu for ₹ 5,08,000. Finally, Financial Year 2025-26-il property sale cheyyaan agreement vekkunnu for ₹ 40,00,000, with an advance of ₹ 2,00,000 received via account payee cheque on agreement date. Ennaal agreement date-ile Stamp Duty Value ₹ 52,00,000 aayirunnu! Ee multi-provision puzzle Section 50C, Section 51, matrum Section 112 vechu namukku solve cheyyaam.

actual_bar.label: Actual Consideration: ₹ 40,00,000 (Advance ₹ 2L by A/c Payee Cheque)

sdv_bar.label: Stamp Duty Value on Agreement Date: ₹ 52,00,000

deemed_stamp.label: Section 50C Deemed Full Value of Consideration: ₹ 52,00,000

beats.voice_sync_text: Nammal aadyam Section 50C-yude agreement date proviso shradhikkannam. Rule ithaanu: Date of agreement-um date of registration-um different aanenkil, agreement date-ile Stamp Duty Value consider cheyyaam, provided advance money account payee cheque vazhiyo electronic clearing system vazhiyo on or before agreement date receive cheythirikkanam. Ivide ₹ 2,00,000 account payee cheque vazhi agreement date-il thanne kittiyathinaal, ₹ 52,00,000 aanu benchmark SDV. Ee SDV actual consideration-te 110 percentinekaal kooduthal aaya kond, Section 50C prakaram full value of consideration aayi ₹ 52,00,000 edukkanam.

title.text: Statutory Mandate: Section 50C Agreement Date Proviso

quote.text: Where the date of agreement fixing the consideration and the date of registration are not the same, the value adopted by the stamp valuation authority on the date of agreement may be taken, provided consideration or part thereof has been received by way of an account payee cheque or electronic clearing system on or before the date of agreement.
quote.citation: Proviso to Section 50C(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961
quote.emphasis: account payee cheque on or before the date of agreement

beats.voice_sync_text: Aduthathayi, Cost of Acquisition calculate cheyyaam. Section 55(2)(b) prakaram 1st April 2001-nu munpu vaangiya asset-nu Fair Market Value ₹ 15,00,000 and Stamp Duty Value ₹ 14,00,000 compare cheythu lower amount edukkuka, athayath ₹ 14,00,000. Actual cost ₹ 5,00,000 aayathinaal higher value aaya ₹ 14,00,000 COA aayi varum. Ini advance forfeiture: June 2009-il forfeit cheytha ₹ 1,50,000 1st April 2014-nu munpaayathinaal Section 51 prakaram COA-il ninnu deduct cheythu ₹ 12,50,000 aakkum. Ennaal July 2016-ile ₹ 2,00,000 Section 56(2)(ix) prakaram Income from Other Sources-il tax cheythathinaal ivide deduct cheyyilla!

Advance forfeited in July 2016 (Post-01-04-2014)

beats.voice_sync_text: Ippo namukku capital gains computation-lekku kadakkaam. Deemed Full Value ₹ 52,00,000-il ninnu brokerage @ 1% on actual price ₹ 40,000 kurachu Net Consideration ₹ 51,60,000 kittunnu. Indexation illathe LTCG ₹ 34,02,000 aanu. Pakshe Finance Act 2024-te amendment prakaram, resident individual-nu 23rd July 2024-nu munpu vaangiya property-il indexation koduthu tax calculate cheyyanulla option undu. Indexed COA ₹ 47,00,000 and Indexed COI ₹ 7,52,000 kurakkumbol ₹ 2,92,000 Long-Term Capital Loss varunnu! Loss vannathinaal indexation scheme-il tax Nil aanu. Assessee-kku beneficial aaya Nil tax liability select cheyyaam!

Randamathathu, Section 51 advance forfeiture cut-off date: 1st April 2014-nu munpulla forfeiture COA-il reduce cheyyumpol, athinu sheshamulla forfeiture Section 56(2)(ix) prakaram IFOS-il tax aakum. Moonnamathathu, Section 112 transitional relief: Real estate acquired before 23rd July 2024 aanenkil, indexation vazhi loss varukayanenkil final tax liability Nil aayi claim cheyyaam!

rules.heading: Section 50C Banking Channel Rule
rules.body: Agreement date Stamp Duty Value is valid only if advance consideration is received via account payee cheque/ECS on or before the agreement date.

rules.heading: Forfeited Advance Dual Mechanism
rules.body: Advance forfeited before 01-04-2014 reduces Cost of Acquisition u/s 51. Advance forfeited on or after 01-04-2014 is taxable under IFOS u/s 56(2)(ix).

rules.heading: Section 112 Beneficial Regime
rules.body: For properties acquired prior to 23-07-2024 by resident individuals, if indexation computation results in capital loss, the tax liability under Section 112 is effectively Nil.

dt-c3-q1.context_pill: Section 32 | Depreciation on Block of Assets & 180-Day Rule

title.text: CA Ananya's Practice: Acquisition of Professional Assets

beats.voice_sync_text: Priypetta vidyarthikale, namukku CA Ananya-yude case nokkam! Previous Year 2025-26-il Ananya puthiya practice thudangi. Aadyamayi office setup cheyyan vendi 1st April 2025-il ₹ 2,50,000 vilamadikkunna second-hand office furniture vaangi put to use cheythu. Randamathathu, 20th September 2025-il ₹ 50,000 cost-il desktop computer vaangi 1st October 2025-il put to use aakki. Moonnamathathu, 5th October 2025-il ₹ 10,000 vilayulla computer UPS vaangi 10th October 2025-il use cheythu. Naalaamathathu, professional books ₹ 20,000-inu 1st April 2025-il thanne vaangi use cheythu. Avasanamayi, 25th September 2025-il ₹ 60,000-nte laptop vaangi 9th October 2025-il aanu put to use cheythath. Ella payments-um account payee cheque vazhiyano. Ippol Assessment Year 2026-27-il Ananya-kku ethra depreciation claim cheyyam ennanu nammal kandethandath.

assessee_person.label: CA Ananya: Commenced practice in P.Y. 2025-26

furniture_asset.label: Office Furniture: ₹ 2,50,000 | Put to use 1st Apr 2025

desktop_asset.label: Desktop Computer: ₹ 50,000 | Put to use 1st Oct 2025

books_asset.label: Professional Books: ₹ 20,000 | Put to use 1st Apr 2025

ups_asset.label: Computer UPS: ₹ 10,000 | Put to use 10th Oct 2025

banking_channel.label: All acquired via Account Payee Cheque

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 32-nte second proviso shradhicho! Previous Year-il acquire cheytha asset, business athallenkil profession-il 180 days-il thazhe mathrame put to use cheythittullu engil, depreciation rate normal prescribed rate-nte 50 percent aayi restrict cheyyum. Athayath 40 percent block-inu verum 20 percent-um, 10 percent block-inu 5 percent-um mathrame kittu. Koodathe rule orkkuka, computers, laptops, UPS, printers, pinne professional books ellam Plant and Machinery block-inte keezhil 40 percent rate-il aanu varunnath.

quote.text: Where an asset is acquired by the assessee during the previous year and is put to use for the purposes of business or profession for a period of less than 180 days in that previous year, the deduction under this sub-section in respect of such asset shall be restricted to 50% of the amount calculated at the percentage prescribed.
quote.citation: Second Proviso to Section 32(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961
quote.emphasis: restricted to 50% of the prescribed percentage if put to use for less than 180 days

context_bubble.speaker: Section 32(1) Proviso
context_bubble.text: Asset acquired in PY & put to use < 180 days gets only 50% of normal depreciation rate

beats.voice_sync_text: Ivide namukku 180 days test apply cheyyam. Previous Year 2025-26 leap year allaathathinaal 365 days aanullath. 3rd October 2025-nu munp put to use cheytha assets 180 days or more use cheythittund. Office furniture 1st April-inu use cheythu, Desktop Computer 1st October-inu use cheythu, athayath 182 days. Books 1st April-inu use cheythu. Athukond ivakku full depreciation kittum. Ennal Laptop put to use cheythath 9th October-inanu, UPS 10th October-inanu. Randum 180 days-il thazhe mathrame use cheythittullu. Athukond 40 percent-inu pakaram ivakku 20 percent mathrame allowable aayittullu.

intro_cards.title: 180 Days in P.Y. 2025-26
intro_cards.body: Cut-off date for full depreciation is put to use on or before 3rd October 2025

divider.title: Period of Active Use during P.Y. 2025-26

story_steps.text: Office Furniture: ₹ 2,50,000 (Put to use 1st Apr 2025 = 365 days) → 10% allowable
Desktop Computer: ₹ 50,000 (Put to use 1st Oct 2025 = 182 days) → 40% allowable
Professional Books: ₹ 20,000 (Put to use 1st Apr 2025 = 365 days) → 40% allowable
Laptop: ₹ 60,000 (Put to use 9th Oct 2025 = 174 days) → Restricted to 20%
Computer UPS: ₹ 10,000 (Put to use 10th Oct 2025 = 173 days) → Restricted to 20%

beats.voice_sync_text: Ini step-by-step mathematical computation nokkam. Onnamathathu, Block 1 Furniture @ 10 percent: ₹ 2,50,000-inte 10 percent eduthal ₹ 25,000 allowable depreciation. Randamathathu, Block 2 Plant & Machinery: Desktop computer ₹ 50,000 @ 40 percent aanu ₹ 20,000. Books ₹ 20,000 @ 40 percent aanu ₹ 8,000. Ini half-rate assets: Laptop ₹ 60,000 @ 20 percent aanu ₹ 12,000, Computer UPS ₹ 10,000 @ 20 percent aanu ₹ 2,000. Plant block-inte total ₹ 42,000 aayi. So Block 1-um Block 2-um koodi koottumbozh total allowable depreciation ₹ 67,000 kittunnu!

title.text: Computation of Allowable Depreciation for A.Y. 2026-27

callout.text: Computers, peripherals, and books constitute 'Plant' eligible for 40% base depreciation, subject to 180-day restriction.

beats.voice_sync_text: Exam hall-il thettikaan paadillatha 3 Golden Rules orkkuka. Onnamathathu, acquisition date alla, 'date put to use' aanu 180 days test-inu nokkendath. Randamathathu, books (annual publications aayalum allekilum), computer peripherals like UPS, printer, scanners ellam Plant & Machinery block-il 40 percent rate-il aanu varunnath. Moonnamathathu, previous year-il acquire cheytha asset-inu mathrame 180 days half-rate restriction apply aaku. Munnarivulla opening WDV-kku ithu baadhakamalla!

title.text: 3 Golden Rules for Section 32 Exam Mastery

rules.heading: Date Put to Use is Decisive
rules.body: The 180-day condition depends strictly on when the asset is 'put to use', not the date of purchase or invoice.

rules.heading: Books & Computer Peripherals are Plant (40%)
rules.body: All books (annual or non-annual), laptops, printers, and UPS form part of the Plant block eligible for 40% depreciation.

rules.heading: Half-Rate Restriction Applies Only in Year of Acquisition
rules.body: The 50% restriction under second proviso to Section 32(1) applies only if the asset is acquired during that same previous year.

dt-c3-q2.context_pill: Section 32 & 43(6) | Depreciation & Additional Depreciation for Power Undertakings

title.text: Kaveri Energy & Power Ltd: P.Y. 2025-26 Asset Matrix

beats.voice_sync_text: Makkale, initial step aayi namukku Kaveri Energy and Power Limited-nte entire factual picture onnu manasilakkam. Company power generation business-il aanu engage cheythirikkunnathu, moreover avaru opt cheythirikkunnathu Section 32 prakaramulla Written Down Value method aanu. Financial Year 2025-26-il company-kkulla opening WDV of 15% Plant and Machinery block ennathu exactly six lakh rupees aanu. Ee varsham company 4 new machinery assets purchase cheythu, koodathe oru second hand machinery-yum vaangi, koode oru old machinery four lakh rupees-inu sell cheythu. Ithil 15% block-il varunna general plant, 40% block-il varunna air pollution control equipment, pinne Section 32(1)(iia) additional depreciation eligible aano alleo ennullathaanu nammude core legal chessboard!

assessee_company.label: Kaveri Energy & Power Ltd (Power Generation Business - WDV Method)

machinery_additions.label: Additions: Turbine A (₹ 10L), Machinery B (₹ 5L), Second Hand (₹ 3L), Office AC (₹ 2L)

beats.voice_sync_text: Section 32(1)(iia) additional depreciation-nte statutory backbone nokkoo. Oru assessee generation or generation and distribution of power-il engage cheythittundengil, new plant and machinery acquire cheythu install cheythal twenty percent additional depreciation labhikkum. Ennal third proviso to Section 32(1) prakaram, asset put to use for less than 180 days aanengil, normal depreciation-um additional depreciation-um fifty percent aayi restrict cheyyum, athayath ten percent maathrame year of acquisition-il kittu. Pakshe second proviso to Section 32(1)(iia) parayunnu, aa balance ten percent additional depreciation immediately succeeding financial year-il deduction aayi claim cheyyam!

quote.text: Where any new machinery or plant is acquired and installed by an assessee engaged in the business of manufacture or production of any article or thing or in the business of generation, transmission or distribution of power, a further sum equal to twenty per cent of the actual cost shall be allowed as deduction... Provided that where an asset is put to use for less than 180 days, such deduction shall be restricted to 50% and the balance 50% shall be allowed in the immediately succeeding previous year.
quote.emphasis: generation, transmission or distribution of power... balance 50% shall be allowed in the immediately succeeding previous year

context_bubble.speaker: Section 32(1)(iia)
context_bubble.text: Power undertakings are eligible for 20% Additional Depreciation; <180 days usage splits claim into 10% in Year 1 and balance 10% in Year 2.

beats.voice_sync_text: Ippo namukku oro asset-nteyum eligibility onnu filter cheyyam. Onnamathathu, Turbine Machinery A ten lakh rupees-inu vaangi June tenth-inu install cheythu, put to use more than 180 days aanu, so full 15% normal depreciation-um 20% additional depreciation-um eligibl aanu. Randamathathu, Machinery B five lakh rupees November twenty-fifth-inu install cheythu, less than 180 days aayathukondu normal depreciation 7.5% and additional depreciation 10% maathrame ee varsham kittu. Moonnamathathu, three lakh rupees-inte second hand machinery-kk additional depreciation strictly denied aanu. Naalaamathathu, administrative office-il vecha two lakh rupees-inte air conditioner-kk Section 32(1)(iia) clause (b) prakaram additional depreciation kittilla. Avasanam, four lakh rupees-inte Air Pollution Control Equipment 40% block-il varum, koodathe 20% additional depreciation-num fully eligible aanu!

beats.voice_sync_text: Ippol namukku General Plant and Machinery fifteen percent block-inte complete computation cheyyam. Opening WDV six lakh rupees. Additions total twenty lakh rupees aanu. Athil ninnu sale consideration aaya four lakh rupees deduct cheythal, depreciation compute cheyyunna munpulla WDV twenty-two lakh rupees aayi maari. Ee twenty-two lakh rupees-il, less than 180 days put to use cheytha second hand machinery three lakh rupees-inum Machinery B five lakh rupees-inum half rate, athayath seven point five percent normal depreciation kodukkum. Balance fourteen lakh rupees-inu full fifteen percent normal depreciation two lakh ten thousand rupees varum. Pine Turbine A-kku twenty percent additional depreciation two lakh rupees-um, Machinery B-kku ten percent additional depreciation fifty thousand rupees-um cherthu total five lakh twenty thousand rupees depreciation deduct cheythal, closing WDV sixteen lakh eighty thousand rupees aakum!

beats.voice_sync_text: Aduthathayi, Air Pollution Control Equipment-nte forty percent block nokkoo. Opening WDV nil aayirunnu. Addition four lakh rupees. Normal depreciation forty percent rate-il one lakh sixty thousand rupees. Section 32(1)(iia) prakaram pollution control equipment new plant and machinery aaya kondum July-il install cheytha kondum full twenty percent additional depreciation eighty thousand rupees kittum. So total depreciation for 40% block two lakh forty thousand rupees aavum, closing WDV one lakh sixty thousand rupees aayi nilkkum. Therefore, Kaveri Energy-kk AY 2026-27-il claim cheyyaavunna total depreciation ennathu five lakh twenty thousand plus two lakh forty thousand, equal to seven lakh sixty thousand rupees aanu!

> [!IMPORTANT] Rule for Apportionment: The aggregate depreciation allowable to the amalgamating company and the amalgamated company shall not exceed the deduction calculated at prescribed rates as if the amalgamation had not taken place.


> [!NOTE] Usage Threshold: Assets put to use for less than 180 days in the previous year attract depreciation at 50% of the normal prescribed rate.

dt-c3-q7.source_provision:
### Statutory Summary Matrix: Section 33AB & NABARD Withdrawals

| Statutory Provision | Core Condition / Threshold | Tax Treatment / Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section 33AB Deduction** | Lower of deposit made within specified time or 40% of business profits | Allowed as business deduction in the year of deposit |
| **NABARD Withdrawal Utilization** | Must be used for approved scheme (e.g. machinery, godown, replanting) | Exempt from deemed income if utilized as per specified scheme |
| **Non-Permissible Withdrawal u/s 33AB(7)** | Amount withdrawn but not utilized within PY or spent on ineligible items | Deemed as Profits and Gains of Business or Profession in that PY |
| **Premature Asset Sale u/s 33AB(8)** | Sale of asset acquired out of deposit before expiry of 8 years | Cost of such asset is deemed as PGBP income in the year of sale |


> [!IMPORTANT] Dual Deduction Restriction: No depreciation or business deduction is allowable on assets acquired out of special account withdrawals if the original deposit was already allowed as a deduction u/s 33AB.


> [!WARNING] Deemed Income Trap: Unutilized withdrawal amounts at the end of the previous year automatically trigger deemed business income under Section 33AB.

director.justification: The scenario requires a sequential calculation of taxable income starting from book profits, incorporating specific statutory deductions under Section 33AB and adding back deemed incomes from misutilization and premature asset sales.

dt-c3-q8.example_summary: G Ltd. claims Section 33AB deduction for tea business profits, manages subsequent fund withdrawals for assets, and navigates the tax implications of premature asset sales and mis-utilization.
dt-c3-q8.source_provision:
### Statutory Summary Matrix: Section 33AB & Rule 8

| Statutory Provision / Rule | Core Condition / Threshold | Tax Treatment & Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section 33AB(1)** | Deposit in Tea Development Account on or before specified due date | Deduction allowed is lower of actual deposit or 40% of composite business profits. |
| **Section 33AB(4)** | Utilization of withdrawn amount for non-permissible assets (e.g. office machinery) | Deemed as profits and gains of business for the previous year of withdrawal. |
| **Section 33AB(6)** | Utilization of withdrawn amount for specified non-depreciable assets | No fresh deduction under Section 33AB since funds originate from already-deducted deposits. |
| **Section 33AB(7)** | Failure to utilize withdrawn amount within the same financial year of withdrawal | Chargeable to tax as business income in the year of withdrawal. |
| **Section 33AB(8)** | Sale of asset acquired out of deposit before expiry of 8 years | Cost of such asset is deemed as profits and gains of business in the year of sale. |
| **Rule 8** | Composite business of growing and manufacturing tea in India | 40% taxable as business income; 60% treated as agricultural income exempt from tax. |

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Segregation Requirement: When any part of a withdrawal amount becomes taxable under Section 33AB, the income must be strictly segregated into 40% business income and 60% agricultural income pursuant to Rule 8 before setting off brought-forward business losses under Section 72.

> [!WARNING]
> Asset Sale Restriction: Selling an asset purchased from a Tea Development Account within 8 years from the end of the acquisition year triggers immediate business income taxability under Section 33AB(8).

director.justification: The scenario requires a multi-step calculation of composite income, deduction limits u/s 33AB, and the subsequent taxability of mis-utilized funds across different assessment years.
director.visual_metaphor: A tea plantation processing plant with a 'Tax Sieve' that separates 40/60 and a 'Deposit Silo' for Section 33AB funds.

### Statutory Summary Matrix: Section 35ABB

| Statutory Parameter | Legal Rule & Condition | Tax Treatment | Deductibility Benchmark |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nature of Expenditure** | Any capital expenditure actually paid for acquiring telecommunication licences | Allowed as amortised deduction | Spread equally over active licence period |
| **Timing: Payment Before Commencement** | Payment made before business commences | Deduction begins in the **year of commencement of business** | Spread over remaining unexpired period |
| **Timing: Payment After Commencement** | Payment made after business commences | Deduction begins in the **year of actual payment** | Spread over remaining unexpired period |

> Duration of Deduction: The deduction continues until the final year in which the licence ceases to be in force. Unexpired period is computed from the relevant previous year until the date of licence expiry.


> [!WARNING]
> Actual Payment Condition: Deduction u/s 35ABB strictly requires **actual payment**. Mere liability or provision accrued does not trigger amortisation until cash outflow occurs.

dt-c3-q13.example_summary: ABC Ltd transfers a building from its specified sugar warehousing unit to a non-specified edible oil unit within the 8-year lock-in period, triggering income recapture.
dt-c3-q13.source_provision:
| Statutory Provision | Core Condition / Trigger | Tax Treatment / Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section 35AD(7B)** | Transfer of asset from specified business to non-specified business before 8 years | Deduction allowed less allowable depreciation u/s 32 is deemed as business income |
| **Section 43(1) Explanation 13** | Subsequent use of asset in non-specified business unit | Actual cost for depreciation is reduced by the depreciation that would have been allowable |


> [!IMPORTANT] Deemed Income Trap: The difference between the Section 35AD deduction and normal depreciation for the intervening period is brought to tax under PGBP.


> [!WARNING] Depreciation Basis: Future depreciation is calculated on the reduced actual cost reflecting notional past depreciation.

director.justification: The scenario involves the recapture of a previously claimed deduction as deemed income and the substitution of the asset's actual cost for future depreciation upon its transfer to a non-specified business.
director.visual_metaphor: A 'Tax Recapture Scale' that balances the original deduction against a new income entry and a reduced cost basis.
